Title: 496853-2026: Italy – Architectural services and construction supervision – OPEN TELEMATICS PROCEDURE, PURSUANT TO ART. 71 OF LEGISLATIVE DECREE 31 MARCH 2023, NO. 36 AND SUBSEQUENT AMENDMENTS, FOR THE AWARD OF THE SERVICE RELATING TO ARCHITECTURE AND ENGINEERING FOR SITE SUPERVISION, HEALTH AND SAFETY COORDINATION DURING THE EXECUTION PHASE AND CONTINUOUS ARCHAEOLOGICAL SUPERVISION FOR THE SEISMIC UPGRADING WORKS OF THE PALAZZO DELLE FINANZE, BOLOGNA
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Seismic upgrading and structural consolidation of a historic government building is structurally demanding and therefore of interest for sbp. However, the project is located in Italy and is not a bridge or large-scale building project in the DACH region, which limits the priority.
titel: Open procedure for site supervision, safety coordination and archaeological supervision for the seismic upgrading of the Palazzo delle Finanze in Bologna
kurzbeschreibung: Site supervision for the seismic upgrading of a historic administrative building in Bologna.
umfang: Service contract for Lot 2 for the seismic upgrading of the Palazzo delle Finanze, Piazza Malpighi 11-19, in particular consolidation of the large cloister. Use of materials and techniques with reduced environmental impact in accordance with minimum environmental criteria as well as digital information management methods. Duration 28 months.
leistungen: Site supervision, health and safety coordination during the execution phase, continuous archaeological supervision.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Administrative building, in principle to be rejected according to sbp guidelines.
• No structural design or design services are being tendered, but mainly site supervision and health and safety coordination.
• Not a bridge, roof, special structure, sports or complex building project with a clear sbp core profile.
• Historic existing building with seismic upgrading could be technically interesting, but offers hardly any strategic entry point for sbp.
• Low contract volume.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs for cost groups 300/400 stated. Only the estimated contract value of the services of EUR 189599.84 net is given; no reliable derivation of construction costs is possible from this.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Suitability criteria and specific reference requirements are stated in the procurement documents, but are not detailed in the TED notice.
zuschlagskriterien: Quality; further criteria and weightings are not stated in the notice.
auftraggeber: Agenzia del Demanio - Direzione Regionale Emilia Romagna, Via Azzo Gardino 61/A, 40122 Bologna, Italy, Contact: Armando Alfonso, E-mail: dre.emiliaromagna@agenziademanio.it, Tel.: 0642367820
notes: Historic building Palazzo delle Finanze in Bologna. The description refers to Lot 2 consolidation of the large cloister, while the lot is designated as Lotto unico or Lot 1; possible inconsistency in the notice. Tender language Italian.
